body:
VERDICT: REPAIR
I completed independent pass 1 of candidate e38b0f9eb06c9bd4bb029ff75deab9f97d083960 against base 1c6397c740d9b64fab471a40f493c6f6acd10bcc, reading the full diff, touched files and tests without withheld narratives.
I found one medium-severity defect: product sorts its input in place, violating AC-4 and R-2 despite the shipped product test passing.
Repair and a regression test remain for the implementation owner; no files were changed by this review.

Per-criterion verdicts:
- AC-4: NOT SATISFIED overall; arithmetic satisfied at src/math.mjs:73 and test/math.test.mjs:86, validation satisfied at src/math.mjs:69-71, no-mutation violated at src/math.mjs:72
- R-1: SATISFIED at src/math.mjs:69-71; Array.isArray, empty RangeError, finite-number TypeError checks confirmed by automated probes
- R-2: NOT SATISFIED at src/math.mjs:72; observed [4,2,3] become [2,3,4]
- R-3: SATISFIED by full diff; existing functions at src/math.mjs:1-65 and existing tests at test/math.test.mjs:5-83 unchanged, with only the permitted import edit at test/math.test.mjs:3
- R-4: SATISFIED by full diff and package.json:1-10; no dependencies or generated paths changed, only src/math.mjs and test/math.test.mjs changed
- R-5: SATISFIED at test/math.test.mjs:85; new test name starts with product

Findings:
- MEDIUM | src/math.mjs:72 (coverage gap at test/math.test.mjs:85-87) | values.sort mutates caller-owned input, explicitly violating AC-4/R-2 and changing state visible to subsequent callers; the only product test uses sorted input and checks only the result | Smallest verification: product([4,2,3]) returns 24 while an assertion confirms the original array remains [4,2,3], under a product-prefixed regression test

Checks actually run:
- git rev-parse HEAD: e38b0f9eb06c9bd4bb029ff75deab9f97d083960, matching candidate
- node --test --test-name-pattern="^product" test/: exit 0; "✔ product of several values"; "tests 1", "pass 1", "fail 0"
- npm test: exit 1; "tests 16", "pass 15", "fail 1"; sole failure "clamp respects upper bound", 15 !== 10 at test/math.test.mjs:14; expected pre-existing defect, unchanged by candidate and not a finding
- Independent node --input-type=module -e assertions: "PASS: AC-4 arithmetic and R-1 validation probes"; mutation probe printed {"result":24,"before":[4,2,3],"after":[2,3,4]} then failed with "AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: product must not mutate its input", exit 1
- Initial heredoc form of the independent probe could not run because the read-only sandbox refused its temporary file; the same assertions were subsequently executed via -e as reported above
- git status --short: empty, clean checkout

Remaining uncertainty: no required checks unavailable; shipped product coverage lacks invalid-input and nonmutation tests, with validation independently checked in memory; no repair performed
